purpose: Behavioral forward-test cases for trigger precision, workflow routing, reference budget, evidence discipline, and negative boundaries.

cases.prompt: 把这个登录页截图高保真还原到现有 HarmonyOS 工程，截图是 390x844，页面在 entry 模块，先做到布局和视觉一致。
acceptance: Inspect the existing project before editing.
Establish screenshot-to-vp coordinate mapping.
Capture runtime evidence on an explicit target or disclose that only L0/L1 is available.
Do not add interactions that are absent from the requested visual surface.
Skip the skill review when the implementation and QA follow the existing workflow without material rework.

cases.prompt: local-demo/index.html?page=profile 这个页面要迁移为 ArkUI，页面有 CSS 渐变、遮罩和自定义字体，只复刻当前静态状态。
acceptance: Capture the rendered page after scripts run instead of trusting source literals.
Record the selected page state, viewport, and crop.
Disclose missing fonts or remote asset substitutions.

cases.prompt: 把 HTML demo 里的底部弹层复刻成 ArkUI：点击打开、拖动跟手、松手按阈值吸附，抬起时把速度交给 spring。
acceptance: Record trigger, snap thresholds, velocity handoff, and interruption.
Verify a drag that starts while the sheet is settling.
Verify short and long releases separately.

cases.prompt: 参考页里有三段错峰动画，反向和快速重复点击时都要从当前帧继续，不能跳回起点。请迁移到 ArkUI 并验证时序。
acceptance: Define per-track phase windows and current-frame cancellation semantics.
Use a high-rate capture or explicitly downgrade timing claims.
Verify that only the latest run commits the final endpoint.
If a missed instruction or late QA finding causes rework, report at most one evidence-backed skill improvement without editing skill files during the replica task.

cases.prompt: HTML 页面滚动时，顶部图片缩小、标题收起、进度线变化。把这个效果还原到 HarmonyOS List 页面。
acceptance: Normalize the scroll callback delta into absolute clamped progress.
Verify upward and downward response and overlay stacking.
Reconstruct an exact intermediate progress after reversal.

cases.prompt: 复刻参考 HTML 的密集 Canvas 粒子按钮效果。已有工程能运行，要求在目标模拟器上给出粒子性能和应用帧率证据。
acceptance: Record particle count, device, build mode, and sampling window.
Separate animation cadence from presented frame rate.
Report unavailable metrics instead of inferring FPS from sparse stills.
Record runtime evidence for the requested performance measurement. State which metrics the target can actually expose.

cases.prompt: 现有 HarmonyOS 个人中心页已经能运行，只把这个页面的头部间距、字体和卡片圆角调整成设计图的样子，不要改业务逻辑。
acceptance: Preserve existing business logic and project conventions.
Limit edits to the requested visual surface.
Report visual differences that cannot be verified without a runtime.

cases.prompt: 给 HarmonyOS 应用新增一个登录 API，处理 token 持久化和网络错误。
acceptance: Do not load this visual replica skill.
Do not inspect or alter visual/motion assets for a backend-only task.

cases.prompt: 帮我自由设计一个全新的 HarmonyOS 音乐首页，不要求还原任何现有页面，风格要有未来感。
acceptance: Do not treat original design work as a replication task.
Do not invent a source reference or pixel baseline.

cases.prompt: 照着附上的 HTML 欢迎页复刻 ArkUI。只保留背景的自动呼吸动效，不需要交互。当前没有连接设备，也不能启动模拟器，请先做实现和本地验证。
acceptance: Do not fabricate runtime or device evidence.
Complete source validation and static implementation where possible.
State the highest completed evidence level and the blocked checks.

cases.prompt: 把参考 HTML 里有亮暗面的旋转立方体复刻进现有 ArkUI 页面。支持暂停和拖拽接管，松手惯性要跟参考一致。
acceptance: Inspect connected edges, visible faces, and phase-dependent lighting on the named target.
Check hold, drag dead zone, inertia, and whether the user pause survives a drag.

cases.prompt: 修复这个 ArkUI 列表重复刷新后选中状态丢失的问题，保留现有布局和动效。
acceptance: Handle the state bug without entering the replication workflow.
